concepts.gloss_en: "Why is Your clothing red?" (Isaiah 63:2), cited as a proof-verse in LM 1:29

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the identical Isaiah 63:2 proof-verse in LM 1:29, with the same vocalization (מַדּוּעַ אָדֹם לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ); the only differences are quotation marks and a pausal/non-pausal ending (לִלְבוּשֶׁךְ / לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ), which is inflectional, not a homograph. They are all used identically in the bechina chain around blood/Shekhinah/blemished covenant.
